integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic numerical replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact positive-temperature zero-concurrence interval edges around the ferromagnetic XYZ DM transition and their low-temperature exponential width law.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record for DOI:10.1142/S0217979210054579 lists primary MSC 81P40.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The two concurrence branches, zero-temperature critical coupling, and qualitative existence of a finite-temperature zero-entanglement interval are credited to Gürkan and Pashaev.
integrity.source_date_basis: The exact source manuscript arXiv:0804.0710 was first public on 2008-04-04; the authors also had an earlier related XYZ manuscript in 2007.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the zero-field ferromagnetic ordering Jz<Jy<Jx<0 and a z-directed DM coupling.
It classifies concurrence zero versus positive, not a finite-temperature thermodynamic phase transition.
The low-temperature symmetry of the two edge displacements is only a leading-order statement.
Equivalent edge formulas may exist under different XYZ/DM coupling conventions.
title: Exact thermal broadening of the DM entanglement gap in a ferromagnetic XYZ dimer
